scope: production Vue/Canvas/Worker + simulated IPC; not installed acceptance
checks: same-library success preserves camera, selected identity and changed native metadata
failed refresh is not empty and does not move the selected view
same-root late success cannot overwrite a newer success or clear its pending state
late previous-root response cannot reintroduce old data or selection in another library
late error cannot erase a successful newer graph
mindmap refresh retains its dragged view, current root and mode
removed selected node does not keep a stale details object
unmounted response is discarded without global errors
